text:
tara: Heads-up: several reports of slow highlight and hover on charts in na-canary after yesterday's reranker rollout. Interaction hangs ~250-600ms when tooltips appear. :thinking_face:
meng: I pulled a trace: https://perf.redwood/fg/1715009999 1 shows long main-thread time spent in `applyHighlights` and `formatRerankResponse`. josh: does reranker return larger payloads now? We changed model variant routing to prefer `rerank-xl` fallback when scores are close. violet: yes, routing.policy.rerank_preference was changed to `prefer_high_quality` and quota.bucket tightened, so we see more fallbacks to heavier model. Also payloads include dense spans and a big highlights regex map.
(quoted config)
```
# rollout 2026-03-21
routing:
  policy:
    rerank_preference: prefer_high_quality
quota:
  bucket:
    size: 120
```

ci-bot: "deploy: reranker-config v3 rolled to na-canary at 1715009950"
tara: flamegraph shows parse loop: `JSON.parse` -> `expandSpans` (heavy regex) -> `applyHighlights` which touches DOM. Regex hotspot is `SPAN_RE` used to merge overlapping spans.
meng: hmm our previous implementation used a worker for span merging but a bundle refactor in the UI moved the merge util into main to avoid worker roundtrip for small dashboards. That was premature.
josh: two levers: 1) prefer lighter reranker variant for canary to reduce payload size 2) move span merge back into worker/lazy-load shared helper 3) loosen quota to reduce prefetch churn.
violet: quick experiment: flip `routing.policy.rerank_preference` to `prefer_latency` for na-canary and enable `highlighter.use_worker=true`. ci-bot: "feature toggle routing.policy.rerank_preference=prefer_latency for na-canary at 1715010010"
ci-bot: "feature toggle highlighter.use_worker=true for na-canary at 1715010012"
tara: after toggles, interaction hitches drop to ~40-90ms. Good. But we need longer-term fixes: add size cap on rerank payloads, add parse/regex perf gate, and add a rollout UX guard to auto-revert rerank preference if main-thread highlight time >150ms over 30s.
meng: I'll open ENG-PLAT-845: rerank payload size cap and ENG-PLAT-846: move span-merge into worker-shared chunk. Also ENG-PLAT-847: perf-gate hook for regex-heavy ops.
josh: we should also revisit quota.bucket.size change. Tighter buckets increased prefetch eviction + repeated rerank calls for same session. Propose setting back to 240 for canary while we test. violet: setting bucket to 240 now. ci-bot: "quota.bucket.size set to 240 in na-canary (change 2026-03-21 12:45UTC)"
tara: follow-ups: - add telemetry metric: rerank-payload-bytes and highlight-regex-time - add canary alert: if applyHighlights median >150ms auto-switch rerank preference - add CI perf test that runs sample rerank payloads through highlight pipeline
meng: noted, I'll assign owners and tag infra. Thanks everyone for quick triage. :rocket:
